sv.title: Minst fyra döda i israeliskt angrepp i Gaza
sv.summary: Tre personer som fraktade förnödenheter i ett fordon till behövande på Gazaremsan dödades i ett angrepp på lördagen, uppger den av terrorstämplade Hamas kontrollerade civilförsvarsmyndigheten.

en.title: At least four dead in Israeli strike in Gaza
en.summary: Three people who were transporting supplies by vehicle to those in need in the Gaza Strip were killed in a strike on Saturday, according to the civil defence authority controlled by Hamas, which is designated as a terrorist organisation.
